svg.title: Briefing a Subagent
svg.desc: A coordinator passes a subagent a structured brief containing prior findings, source metadata and quality criteria; several subagents are spawned in one response to run in parallel.
svg.text: It sees only its prompt, so the prompt carries the findings, the sources and the goal.
Allowed in the coordinator's tools; one AgentDefinition per type
PARALLEL: SEVERAL TASK CALLS IN ONE RESPONSE
